latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of environment-doc-author

- Verifies actual local environment facts before using commands or generating environment-related documents.
- Supports both JavaScript (Node.js) and Python 3.7+ implementations for environment detection and document rendering.
- Creates/refreshes machine-readable (JSON) and human-readable (Markdown) environment baselines and policy fragments from verified facts only.
- Prevents inventing or assuming unverified tools, versions, or settings—everything must be probed on the current machine.
- Avoids overwriting agent documents unless explicitly instructed; produces separate environment snippets by default.
- Implements strict approval process for any action that would install, update, or reconfigure local software.
